What is DacityCoin, and what do these totals mean?

DacityCoin is the AudaCity token on Solana. View the exact token on Pump. The planned JANITOR / DacityCoin pair uses DacityCoin as its quote asset. Pairing does not make JANITOR a share in AudaCity or give holders ownership of the union treasury.

Collected fees, the treasury’s current holdings, allocations and paid rewards are different figures. An allocation is reserved funding, not a completed payment. No balance is inferred from trading volume, and missing records display a dash.

Union expenses and worker payouts follow the funding agreement. The final operating budget and payout terms must be adopted before funds move.
